subject: general
question: "Ambubachi Mela" is held in which place?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Guwahati**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Ambubachi Mela** is held annually at the **Kamakhya Temple** in **Guwahati, Assam, India**.
 
• It is a** four-day festival** to mark the menstruation of the **Goddess Kamakhya, believed to be the earth's period of menstruation.**
 
• During this time the temple remains closed for three days, and it is believed that the **earth becomes unclean**.
 
• On the fourth day, **the temple reopens and a large number of devotees visit to receive prasad (holy offering).​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pune: **

 
 
• The city of Pune is famous for** the Osho International Meditation Resort, hence, the Osho Festival of Music and Meditation attracts many visitors from around the world.**
 
• Pune also hosts the **Sawai Gandharva Bhimsen Festival, one of the largest Indian Classical music festivals in India.**
 
 
 
• **Patna: **
 
 
• **The city of Patna** in** Bihar** is famous for** the Chhath Puja, an ancient Hindu festival dedicated to the Sun God Surya.**
 
• **The Chhath Puja** involves **rigorous rituals, including fasting and standing in water for long periods.**
 
 
 
• **Lucknow**:
 
 
• **Lucknow,** the capital city of** Uttar Pradesh,** is known for the **Muharram festival, which is observed to mourn the death of Imam Hussain, the grandson of Prophet Mohammed.**
 
• The city is famous for the elaborate processions carried out during **Muharram**.
 
• It also hosts **Lucknow Mahotsav,** an annual event** showcasing arts, crafts, and the rich cultural heritage of Lucknow.**
